title: Core Pydantic data models
context: PRD section 7 defines CheckoutSession, LineItem, Buyer, Address, AuditEntry. These are the backbone models every later endpoint will use.
objective: Implement Pydantic models exactly matching PRD §7, with validation.
scope_in: CheckoutSession model with status enum: created, updated, ready_for_payment, completed, rejected, cancelled
LineItem, Buyer, Address, Totals, PaymentProvider sub-models
AuditEntry model with required reason field when action == reject
Basic validation: quantity > 0, currency is a valid ISO code, totals are non-negative
scope_out: No database persistence yet — models only
acceptance_criteria: All models importable from a single models.py or models/ package
pytest suite validates: invalid quantity raises ValidationError, missing reason on a reject AuditEntry raises ValidationError
Models match PRD §7 field-for-field — no undocumented fields added without asking first
